rows.subtype: Crush × Caste, religion or family barrier [Actor]
rows.description: You like someone your family may not accept. Wise: think seriously about what you both really want and how you will handle family, rather than assuming love alone will win. Immature: secrecy that ends in a sudden crisis.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, comparison, fear, obsession, rejection

rows.description: You choose one person and its meaning goes beyond feelings. Wise: love shows in reliability, honest talk and making room for their growth. Immature: treating commitment as ownership or a performance for social media.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, dependence, fear, gratitude, respect, trust

rows.description: You feel chosen and valued, which is both warm and a little scary. Wise: receive it with honesty about your own limits and keep your own friendships. Immature: taking the devotion for granted.

rows.description: You choose to believe them without proof at every moment. Wise: trust builds through small kept promises and is not blind; you can still notice red flags. Immature: testing them constantly to feel safe.

rows.description: You lean on them for mood, decisions and identity, and feel lost alone. Wise: keep your own friends, work and goals so love is a choice, not a need. Immature: making them responsible for your whole happiness.

rows.description: Your partner needs you constantly and it feels heavy. Wise: give care but name the limit kindly and encourage their other supports. Harmful: feeling guilty into giving up your own life.

rows.description: You want a partner who is equal, not a fantasy or servant. Wise: share decisions, listen to their ambitions, and split effort fairly. Immature: expecting them to follow your career or adjust always.

rows.description: You notice what they do quietly, like showing up in a hard week. Wise: say thanks specifically and reciprocate. Immature: keeping a score of favours and sulking when they are not repaid.

rows.description: You feel anxious they will leave, so you clutch or please too much. Wise: name the fear, work on your own worth, and talk openly. Immature: checking phones or picking fights to test them.

rows.description: Different cities, time zones and studies make you feel forgotten. Wise: agree on realistic contact, share your inner life, and plan visits. Immature: demanding constant replies or reading silence as betrayal.
